description: Kept the book as written, and did not lend it.
name: John Heminges

description: Kept the cold on the river, laughed at the clerk to come, and claimed Saturday.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Took base and common as praise, asked for it in writing, and swore the night before.
name: Will Kemp

description: Refused a verdict, stayed out of the hall, and promised the Jackdaw.
name: William Shakespeare
